title: BBQ Chicken Bowls
reject_reason: Spice-rubbed BBQ chicken over rice with sweet potato and black-bean-corn salad is the same BBQ-chicken-rice-bowl dinner as live bbq-chicken-rice-bowls (Lean BBQ Chicken and Rice Bowls), which already sits beside slow-cooker-bbq-pulled-chicken-bowls; sides don't make a new plate.
